defs.def: a long thin straight piece of wood or metal, especially one with the end placed in the ground, used as a support 柱子；杆子；棍；杖

ex.s: A far cry from the bright lights and shiny courts of the National Basketball Association (NBA), it was along this road that Stephen's grandfather built a simple basket by attaching a piece of plastic to a telephone pole.
ex.t: 与全国篮球协会（ NBA ）的明亮灯光和闪亮球场相去甚远，正是在这条路上，斯蒂芬的祖父通过将一块塑料连接到电线杆上，建造了一个简单的篮子。

ex.s: Along this road, Stephen’s grandfather built a simple basket by fixing a piece of plastic to a telephone pole.
ex.t: 沿着这条路，Stephen 的祖父用一块塑料板固定做了一个简易的篮筐。

defs.def: either of the two points at the opposite ends of the line on which the earth or any other planet turns （行星的）极；地极

ex.s: A regular character in the letters was Polar Bear,who once climbed the North Pole (an actual pole in this case) and fell through the roof of Father Christmas’s house.
ex.t: 字母中的一个普通人物是北极熊，他曾经爬过北极（在这种情况下是实际的极点） ，从圣诞老人家的屋顶上掉了下来。

ex.s: Your next destination: the Antarctic, to journey to the South Pole.
ex.t: 你的下一个目的地：南极洲，前往南极点之旅。

ex.s: The Lord of the Rings was published in three volumes in 1954 and 1955, and has become one of the world's best-selling novel 2 Every Christmas, an envelope with a North Pole stamp arrived.
ex.t: 《指环王》于 1954 年和 1955 年分三卷出版，已成为世界上最畅销的小说之一 2 每年圣诞节，一封带着北极邮戳的信封都会如期而至。

defs.def: either of the two ends of a magnet, or the positive or negative points of an electric battery 磁极；电极
either of two opposite or contrasting extremes （对立或相反的）任何一方；极端
